'''Lord Kherus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pure-blood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a disciple of [[Komok-Da]], Kherus was an exceptional swordsman who fought as a member of [[Darth Ikoral]]'s crew on the [[Red Reaper]]. He died defending the Sith dreadnaught in the [[Battle of the Red Reaper]].
